evidence_boundary.stress_pass_does_not_establish: Learning quality, superiority of class weighting, action support, navigation competence, or any C1-C4 claim.
evidence_boundary.stress_pass_establishes: The exact weighted objective executes four fresh-model updates through the first high-weight STOP exposure with finite gradients, clipping, optimizer state, and trainable changes.

action_codebook.system_prompt: You are a spatial navigation assistant. Given an indoor RGB-D observation and a navigation instruction, choose exactly one official action ID: 0=STOP, 1=MOVE_FORWARD, 2=TURN_LEFT, 3=TURN_RIGHT. Respond only with `Action ID: N`, replacing N with the chosen ID.

evidence_boundary.established_if_passed: This adaptive train-only class-balanced correction met the original native-C0 open-loop existence conditions at the frozen budget.
evidence_boundary.not_established: Independent confirmation, class-weighting superiority, closed-loop navigation competence, val_seen or val_unseen performance, or any C1-C4 geometry claim.

existence_gate.interpretation_if_failed: Native C0 was not demonstrated at this frozen rate, seed, horizon, and data budget; failure is not evidence that C0 cannot learn.
existence_gate.interpretation_if_passed: Native C0 beat the frozen blind references under this train-only existence-test budget; this is not closed-loop navigation evidence.
